title: Real-time mode in Lakeflow pipelines is now generally available
body: Real-time mode in Lakeflow pipelines is now generally available on classic compute and serverless compute. Use it for operational workloads that need end-to-end latency as low as five milliseconds, such as fraud detection. See [Use real-time mode in Lakeflow pipelines](/aws/en/ldp/real-time).
